analysis: Both units are unchanged BASE excerpts of docs/architecture/inference.md (lines 6377-6792). The complete range map shows changes only at base 453 and 3219-3221 and at head 453-473, 3239-3242 and 3255-3286, none inside these units. The excerpts cover four documented areas. First, the dev memory fault (line 6410-6419): it is read and deleted at request start and never read in a production install. Second, build binding for pairs (6421-6425). Third, MiMo and GLM tensor-parallel sealed sums (AES-256-GCM over the keyed JACCL data plane, 6766). Fourth, GLM TP prefix-cache tenant partitions and the SSD tier at 6766, relevant to T-041 and SEC-035: entries are scoped per partition, use prefixDiskScope, and restore only after a second sealed exchange. Line 6770 documents that ClusterGLMTensorParallel.decodeSwitches forwards environment switches into the worker. Line 6743 states release builds cannot force MiMo TP. These are pre-existing documented behaviors with no change in this batch, so no regression is attributable here. The patch at head 453-473 concerns cluster onboarding stop counting: ClusterSetupRecord.stopsAsked and ClusterControlReply.stopsAsked, which is nil from older builds. That text is outside these units and should be reviewed in its own batch, including whether a peer-reported stop count can be spoofed to abort onboarding; this would be a local availability concern against A-018. That patch is documentation only, and no source implementation was supplied.
